navbar.notes: navy-900 top bar, 64px tall, 2px brand-red bottom border; navbar__brand (warehouse app icon + 'StockFlow') left, navbar__link right; active link gets navbar__link--active. Every feature page reachable from a link here.

page.notes: warm-oat page bg, centered ~960px content column; page__header holds page__title with the warehouse icon (page__title-icon) next to the name.

card.notes: white surface, soft navy-tinted --shadow-sm, --radius-lg, --space-5 padding; the stock table and detail panels live in cards.

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand-red, sharp 0 corners, for Receive/Pick/Save/active), btn--secondary (outlined, --radius-md), btn--ghost (text-only). Tap target >= 44x44px.

form_input.notes: persistent visible label above input (never placeholder-only); field__label, field__input with --color-info focus ring, field__error shown inline next to the offending field naming it.

table.notes: cool uppercase header row; quantity cells right-aligned via stock-table__num in --font-mono with tabular-nums; calm high-contrast rows for scanning.

status_badge.notes: pill, --text-xs uppercase; state carried by BOTH text and color, never color alone.

scan_zone.notes: primary barcode input on the warehouse floor; scan-zone--success green flash + row updates in place, scan-zone--error red flash + persistent error toast.

empty_state.notes: icon + teaching heading (empty-state__title) + copy + a CTA, never a blank region (e.g. 'No stock at this location, receive an inbound shipment'); also the 'not tracked' state for SKUs with no batch/serial detail.

toast.notes: fixed top-right, no layout shift; toast--ok auto-dismisses, toast--error persists.

app_icon.notes: the warehouse mark from client/public/warehouse.png, rendered in the navbar next to 'StockFlow' (navbar__icon), in the page title (page__title-icon), and set as the browser-tab favicon in index.html.
